findings.rawBody:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Compare control outputs before accepting them**

At reviewed head `bb642ab3897fa587b1f41f8298533229874f9617` (tree `c5186276933a74715e6c2e4f9a43e034d2c67818`), when a YAML, Unity-asset, FightMatch, or 005 candidate exits with the expected status but produces output different from the oracle, `assert_controls` checks only the receipt role, argv, quiescence, and exit code before succeeding. It never performs the semantic, raw-byte, or canonical comparisons required by `controlAssertions.otherBControls`, so a behaviorally broken B build can pass the final harness.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L299-L301](https://github.com/yyczz1/FightMatch/blob/bb642ab3897fa587b1f41f8298533229874f9617/AGENTS.md#L299-L301)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require the B runner to cover expected deployment**

When a future B build omits required assemblies or resources and its receipt lists the same truncated files, this equality still passes because it compares the directory only with the receipt's self-declared set. The positive fixture confirms that just `YamlDotNet.dll` and two license files are accepted; the gate never joins `runnerFiles` to the frozen `expected-deployment.tsv` or package closure. An incomplete, nonfunctional runner can therefore be marked valid and passed into L.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L299-L301](https://github.com/yyczz1/FightMatch/blob/bb642ab3897fa587b1f41f8298533229874f9617/AGENTS.md#L299-L301)

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind execution to a verifiable central activation**

When `execute` is invoked with caller-constructed stdin, any caller can satisfy this gate by copying the public central thread constant and inventing an `ownerTurn`; no central host, activation turn/item, or hash-bound central receipt is required. Consequently the driver cannot distinguish the separately authorized execution required by M14/M16 from a locally fabricated activation before starting the two restores and creating T16/M16.
